questions.content:
7. (60 分)

(1) S 系中有一初始静止在 $(0, mc^{2}/F)$ 处的，静质量为 m 的质点，受到一沿 y 方向的力 F 作用，F 值为相对质点静止的瞬时惯性系中测量到的值，它恰好为一常数。粒子携带一个钟，粒子静止时示数 $\tau = 0$。质点不断向上加速运动过程中钟示数增量 $\mathrm{d}\tau$ 与相对质点静止的瞬时惯性系中经过的时间一致。计算在当质点上携带的钟的时间为 $\tau$ 时，质点的纵坐标 $y$ 与 $y$ 方向速度 $v_{y}$。

(2) 考虑参考系 $S'$，它相对 S 系向 $x$ 轴负方向以速度 $v_{0}$ 做匀速直线运动。在新参考系 $S'$ 中，重新计算当质点上携带的钟的时间为 $\tau$ 时，质点的坐标 $(x',y')$ 与速度 $(v_{x}', v_{y}')$。

(3) 计算参考系 $S'$ 中质点受力的水平分量与竖直分量 $(F'_{x}, F'_{y})$、质点加速度的水平分量与竖直分量 $(a_{x}', a_{y}')$。

(4) 计算参考系 $S'$ 中质点受力的切向分量与法向分量 $(F'_{\tau}, F'_{n})$、质点加速度的切向分量与法向分量 $(a_{\tau}', a_{n}')$。切向即平行于质点速度方向，法向即垂直于质点速度方向。

(5) 定义“纵向质量”、“横向质量”：

$$
m_{\tau} = \frac{F_{\tau}'}{a_{\tau}'} \quad , \quad m_{n} = \frac{F_{n}'}{a_{n}'}
$$

计算这两个质量，如果可能的话，利用 $m$ 与 $S'$ 系中的相对速率 $v' = \sqrt{v_{x}'^{2} + v_{y}'^{2}}$ 表示。提示：

双曲函数：

$$
\mathrm{sh}\ x = \frac{\mathrm{e}^{x} - \mathrm{e}^{-x}}{2} \quad , \quad \mathrm{ch}\ x = \frac{\mathrm{e}^{x} + \mathrm{e}^{-x}}{2}
$$

$$
(\operatorname{sh} x)' = \operatorname{ch} x \quad , \quad (\operatorname{ch} x)' = \operatorname{sh} x
$$

$$
(\operatorname{arch}x)' = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + x^{2}}} \quad , \quad (\operatorname{arch}x)' = \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}}
$$

$$
\operatorname{th} x = \frac{\operatorname{sh} x}{\operatorname{ch} x} \quad , \quad (\operatorname{th} x)' = \frac{1}{\operatorname{ch}^{2} x} \quad , \quad (\operatorname{arth} x)' = \frac{1}{x^{2} - 1}
$$
questions.analysis:
(1)

当速度为 v 且相对粒子静止的惯性系经过时间 dτ 时:

$$
\mathrm{d}v_{0}=\frac{F}{m}\mathrm{d}\tau\tag{①}
$$

但是由于动钟变慢，实际时间变化

$$
\mathrm{d}t = \frac{\mathrm{d}\tau}{\sqrt{1 - v^{2}/c^{2}}}\tag{②}
$$

实际速度变化:

$$
\mathrm{d}v = \frac{v + \mathrm{d}v_{0}}{1 + v\mathrm{d}v_{0}/c^{2}} - v\tag{③}
$$

对上式近似:

$$
\mathrm{d}v = \mathrm{d}v_{0}\left(1 - \frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}\right)\tag{④}
$$

得到微分方程:

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}v}{1 - v^{2}/c^{2}} = \frac{F}{m}\mathrm{d}\tau\tag{⑤}
$$

积分之，利用初始条件:

$$
v = c \operatorname{th} \frac{F \tau}{m c}\tag{⑥}
$$

从而有:

$$
\mathrm{d}t = \mathrm{d}\tau\mathrm{ch}\frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{⑦}
$$

上两式相乘:

$$
\mathrm{d}y = c\mathrm{d}\tau\mathrm{sh}\ \frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{⑧}
$$

对上式积分并注意到初始条件恰好有:

$$
y = \frac{mc^{2}}{F} \mathrm{ch} \frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{⑨}
$$

(2)

首先积分得到 t - τ 关系:

考虑洛伦兹逆变换:

$$
t = \frac{mc}{F} \sin \frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{⑩}
$$

$$
x = 0 = \frac{x' - v_{0}t'}{\sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}}}\tag{⑪}
$$

$$
t = \frac{t' - v_{0}x'/c^{2}}{\sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}}}\tag{⑫}
$$

$$
y' = y\tag{⑬}
$$

这就得到新时间关系:

$$
t' = \frac{mc}{F\sqrt{1 - v_0^2/c^2}} \mathrm{sh} \frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{⑭}
$$

和坐标关系:

$$
x' = \frac{mv_{0}c}{F\sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}}}\mathrm{sh}\frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{⑮}
$$

$$
y' = \frac{mc^{2}}{F} \mathrm{ch} \frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{⑯}
$$

从而将三个关系代入:

$$
v_{x}' = \frac{\mathrm{d}x'}{\mathrm{d}t'} \quad , \quad v_{y}' = \frac{\mathrm{d}y'}{\mathrm{d}t'}\tag{⑰}
$$

得到:

$$
v_{x}' = v_{0}\tag{⑱}
$$

$$
v_{y}' = c \sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}} \operatorname{th} \frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{⑲}
$$

(3)

粒子的膨胀因子:

$$
\gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - \left(v_{x}'^{2} + v_{y}'^{2}\right)/c^{2}}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}}} \mathrm{ch} \frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{⑳}
$$

从而粒子的动量:

$$
p_{x}' = \gamma m v_{x}' = \frac{m v_{0}}{\sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}}} \mathrm{ch} \frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{㉑}
$$

$$
p_{y}' = \gamma m v_{y}' = m c \mathrm{sh} \frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{㉒}
$$

代入:

$$
a_{x}' = \frac{\mathrm{d}v_{x}'}{\mathrm{d}t'} \quad , \quad a_{y}' = \frac{\mathrm{d}v_{y}'}{\mathrm{d}t'}\tag{㉓}
$$

$$
F_{x}' = \frac{\mathrm{d}p_{x}'}{\mathrm{d}t'} \quad , \quad F_{y}' = \frac{\mathrm{d}p_{y}'}{\mathrm{d}t'}\tag{㉔}
$$

得到:

$$
a_{x}' = 0\tag{㉕}
$$

$$
a_{y}' = \frac{F}{m}\left(1 - \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}\right)\mathrm{ch}^{-3}\frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{㉖}
$$

$$
F_{x}' = \frac{v_{0}F}{c}\mathrm{th}\frac{F\tau}{mc}\tag{㉗}
$$

$$
F_{y}' = F\sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}}\tag{㉘}
$$

(4)

速度方向的切向单位矢量:

$$
\tau = \frac{\left( \frac{v_{0}}{c} \mathrm{ch} \frac{F\tau}{mc}, \sqrt{1 - \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}} \mathrm{sh} \frac{F\tau}{mc} \right)}{\sqrt{\mathrm{sh}^{2} \frac{F\tau}{mc} + \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}}}\tag{㉙}
$$

故法向量:

$$
\mathbf{n} = \frac{\left( - \sqrt{1 - \cfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}} \mathrm{sh} \cfrac{F\tau}{mc}, \cfrac{v_{0}}{c} \mathrm{ch} \cfrac{F\tau}{mc} \right)}{\sqrt{\mathrm{sh}^{2} \cfrac{F\tau}{mc} + \cfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}}}.\tag{㉚}
$$

重新投影:

$$
F_{\tau}' = \tau \cdot F' \quad , \quad F_{n}' = n \cdot F'\tag{㉛}
$$

$$
a_{\tau}' = \tau \cdot a' \quad , \quad a_{n}' = n \cdot a'\tag{㉜}
$$

得到:

$$
F_{\tau}' = F \mathrm{sh} \frac{F\tau}{mc} \Bigg/ \sqrt{\mathrm{sh}^{2} \frac{F\tau}{mc} + \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}}
$$

$$
F_{n}' = \left. \frac{v_{0}F}{c} \sqrt{1 - \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}} \mathrm{ch}^{-1} \frac{F\tau}{mc} \right/ \sqrt{\left. \mathrm{sh}^{2} \frac{F\tau}{mc} + \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}} \right|}\tag{㉞}
$$

$$
a_{\tau}' = \frac{F}{m} \left(1 - \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}\right)^{3/2} \mathrm{sh} \frac{F\tau}{mc} \mathrm{ch}^{-3} \frac{F\tau}{mc} \Bigg/ \sqrt{\mathrm{sh}^{2} \frac{F\tau}{mc} + \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}}\tag{㉟}
$$

$$
a_{n}' = \frac{F v_{0}}{m c} \left(1 - \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}\right) \mathrm{ch}^{-2} \frac{F\tau}{mc} \Bigg/ \sqrt{\mathrm{sh}^{2} \frac{F\tau}{mc} + \frac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}}\tag{㊱}
$$

(5)

做比容易发现:

$$
m_{\tau} = \frac{m}{\left(1 - v'^{2}/c^{2}\right)^{3/2}}\tag{㊲}
$$

$$
m_{n} = \frac{m}{\sqrt{1 - v'^{2}/c^{2}}}\tag{㊳}
$$
questions.answer:
(1) $y = \dfrac{mc^{2}}{F} \mathrm{ch} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc}$，$v_{y} = c \operatorname{th} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc}$；

(2) $x' = \dfrac{mv_{0}c}{F\sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}}}\mathrm{sh}\dfrac{F\tau}{mc}$，$y' = \dfrac{mc^{2}}{F} \mathrm{ch} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc}$，$v_{x}' = v_{0}$，$v_{y}' = c \sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}} \operatorname{th} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc}$；

(3) $F_{x}' = \dfrac{v_{0}F}{c}\mathrm{th}\dfrac{F\tau}{mc}$，$F_{y}' = F\sqrt{1 - v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}}$，$a_{x}' = 0$，$a_{y}' = \dfrac{F}{m}\left(1 - \dfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}\right)\mathrm{ch}^{-3}\dfrac{F\tau}{mc}$；

(4) $F_{\tau}' = F \mathrm{sh} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc} \Big/ \sqrt{\mathrm{sh}^{2} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc} + \dfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}}$，$F_{n}' = \dfrac{v_{0}F}{c} \sqrt{1 - \dfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}} \mathrm{ch}^{-1} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc} \Big/ \sqrt{\mathrm{sh}^{2} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc} + \dfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}}$，$a_{\tau}' = \dfrac{F}{m} \left(1 - \dfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}\right)^{3/2} \mathrm{sh} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc} \mathrm{ch}^{-3} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc} \Big/ \sqrt{\mathrm{sh}^{2} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc} + \dfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}}$，$a_{n}' = \dfrac{F v_{0}}{m c} \left(1 - \dfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}\right) \mathrm{ch}^{-2} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc} \Big/ \sqrt{\mathrm{sh}^{2} \dfrac{F\tau}{mc} + \dfrac{v_{0}^{2}}{c^{2}}}$；

(5) $m_{\tau} = \dfrac{m}{\left(1 - v'^{2}/c^{2}\right)^{3/2}}$，$m_{n} = \dfrac{m}{\sqrt{1 - v'^{2}/c^{2}}}$。
